tests.title: Build and module boundary
tests.procedure: Configure the recorded engine/toolchain; build the Editor target and a runtime-only module/dependency check.
tests.expected: Both succeed with no runtime dependency on editor modules; archive commands and logs.

tests.title: Exact ownership tree
tests.procedure: Create each hierarchy level and all five place-type identity shells; try a cycle and orphan parent.
tests.expected: World and Root are aliases for one record; valid place parents are highway points; invalid ownership is rejected.

tests.title: Stable IDs and reparent
tests.procedure: Rename and reparent a city/highway/place; undo/redo; save/reopen.
tests.expected: GUIDs and references remain stable; dependency review identifies affected descendants.

tests.title: Per-segment-end tangents
tests.procedure: Use a point with at least three connected segment ends and unequal/negative tangent values.
tests.expected: Each endpoint retains its own binding and values; no single shared tangent replaces them.

tests.title: Closed loops and duplicates
tests.procedure: Scan a closed loop, repeated shared point and repeated import; rescan twice.
tests.expected: No duplicate points/segments or broken loop closure; source order does not redefine identity.

tests.title: Source transforms and grade separation
tests.procedure: Read rotated/scaled source actors and roads crossing at different elevations.
tests.expected: Resolved geometry is consistent in the declared units/frame; XY overlap does not create topology.

tests.title: Rescan preserves semantics
tests.procedure: Attach authored codes, feature stubs and place offsets; move source geometry; reconcile.
tests.expected: Compatible authored values survive and derived transforms update without authoring copies of source geometry.

tests.title: Split/merge reconciliation
tests.procedure: Split and merge bound source segments; attempt Apply with unmapped references.
tests.expected: Affected IDs are remapped explicitly or blocked; no orphan places or silently discarded metadata.

tests.title: Unloaded is not deleted
tests.procedure: Unload a source partition, scan and reopen it.
tests.expected: State is unavailable/unloaded until resolved; no deletion is inferred from temporary absence.

tests.title: Map and tab lifecycle
tests.procedure: Change maps, reopen tabs, switch mode and alter selection during source refresh.
tests.expected: Old source handles are invalidated; no stale callbacks, stuck selection or unintended source edit occurs.

tests.title: Transactional edits
tests.procedure: Create/apply A; draft B; cancel/revert B; undo/redo A from toolbar and keyboard.
tests.expected: One accepted action is one transaction; cancel restores pre-drag state and Revert affects only the draft.

tests.title: Interrupted save and conflicts
tests.procedure: Inject failure before replacement and open a stale draft against a newer saved revision.
tests.expected: Last valid save survives; recovery and three-way conflict review are explicit; no data is overwritten silently.

tests.title: Landscape preservation
tests.procedure: Fingerprint Landscape content before and after scan, semantic save and reopen.
tests.expected: Read/save paths leave geometry assets unchanged; no rebuild or terrain mutation is hidden in saving.

tests.title: Schema and legacy import
tests.procedure: Load a supported test legacy fixture, unknown schema version and duplicate import into a backup workspace.
tests.expected: Supported data has a reviewed diff; unsupported data is preserved/rejected safely; import is repeatable.

tests.title: Vertical slice and usability
tests.procedure: Author one highway and place; serialize/reopen; operate Basic at 1920×1080 and 125%/150% display scale.
tests.expected: IDs/bindings round-trip; dark/light, focus, tooltips and ordinary authoring work without opening Advanced.

tests.title: Four-level precedence
tests.procedure: Assign one slot at Root, State, City and Highway; clear them from nearest to farthest.
tests.expected: Source changes Highway → City → State → Root; clearing Root yields a typed missing-required-entry issue.

tests.title: Partial catalog and nulls
tests.procedure: Override only a City shelter; leave its road entry absent; remove City/State config references.
tests.expected: Each slot resolves independently; absent asset/entry inherits and does not copy parent values into children.

tests.title: Broken explicit asset
tests.procedure: Assign an invalid Highway path while a valid Root fallback exists; disable an optional feature separately.
tests.expected: Broken assignment blocks instead of silently falling through; disabled optional feature is not treated as null inheritance.

tests.title: Mesh interfaces and shared owner
tests.procedure: Resolve a shared-topology fixture using an explicit owner; swap an incompatible lane-width/port/pivot variant.
tests.expected: Owner choice is deterministic; mismatched interface produces an actionable error naming the port/slot.

tests.title: 6→4 forward merge
tests.procedure: Build the 3-forward-lane to 2-forward-lane fixture and remove the dropped lane successor.
tests.expected: All valid inputs have continuous approved successors; the negative fixture is blocked with lane identity.

tests.title: 6→4 reverse branch
tests.procedure: Traverse the same physical adapter in reverse travel, from two lanes toward three.
tests.expected: Explicit branch options exist; direction, access and no-wrong-way rules are preserved.

tests.title: 4→2 and 6→2 staging
tests.procedure: Build both travel directions for 4→2 and an explicitly supported direct/staged 6→2 preset.
tests.expected: Every lane transition is mapped and has enough validated geometry; unsupported abrupt transitions cannot publish.

tests.title: Asymmetric and one-way
tests.procedure: Use 4+2, 2+0 and bus-only lanes with independent width/access settings.
tests.expected: Total count never substitutes for direction/profile semantics; forbidden participant types are rejected.

tests.title: Width/count edits and identity
tests.procedure: Change lane width without count, then add/remove a lane and inspect stable ID remapping.
tests.expected: Widths and corridors refresh together; unaffected IDs survive and removed lane references are reviewed.

tests.title: Interior adapter interval
tests.procedure: Place a semantic adapter inside a curved source segment; edit its station range and rescan.
tests.expected: Range is explicit and valid; no hidden source split or Landscape mutation is introduced.

tests.title: Driving-side convention
tests.procedure: Mirror a controlled profile fixture between left/right driving using the approved policy.
tests.expected: Lane identity rules stay stable; directional ordering and allowed mappings change consistently.

tests.title: Mesh seam and marking quality
tests.procedure: Join straight, curve and adapter boundaries using existing assets.
tests.expected: Profile boundaries align; sidewalk/border continuity, normals and material conventions match; no unintended end caps or separate lane-marker meshes.

tests.title: Banked curve containment
tests.procedure: Sweep the configured vehicle envelope through a banked curve and adapter using agreed tolerances.
tests.expected: Usable corridors and mesh surface agree; geometric failures are reported, not hidden by resampling or clamping.

tests.title: Build failure and ownership
tests.procedure: Repeat a preview build; inject failure/cancel before replacement with unrelated scene assets present.
tests.expected: No duplicate generated output; last valid preview remains; unrelated assets are untouched.

tests.title: History, persistence and cache
tests.procedure: Change a parent mesh and segment profile; undo/redo, rescan, save/reopen and compare resolved results.
tests.expected: Only affected derived output invalidates; authored values and inheritance semantics round-trip.

tests.title: Canonical junction identity
tests.procedure: Connect three highways to one shared junction, including a boundary between cities; rebuild in different orders.
tests.expected: Only one canonical junction is generated; explicit owner and scope membership remain stable.

tests.title: Typed junction movements
tests.procedure: Test T, cross, skewed and mixed-profile arms with legal/prohibited/U-turn cases.
tests.expected: Only approved directed lane connectors exist; invalid arms and prohibited movements are rejected.

tests.title: Shared intersection transform
tests.procedure: Rotate/bank a shared intersection at non-right angles and change its declared mesh owner.
tests.expected: Mesh, port frames, lane paths, signals and offsets align; ownership does not follow traversal order.

tests.title: Roundabout identity and schema
tests.procedure: Reference one roundabout from four highway points; inspect ring lanes, ports, circulation and scope references.
tests.expected: One canonical ID is counted once per requested scope; required entry/exit and yield data are present.

tests.title: Feature-component consistency
tests.procedure: Toggle a crossing/signal, undo/redo and import a flag that disagrees with its component links.
tests.expected: Switches reflect backing records; incompatible summaries or dangling dependencies cannot be saved/published silently.

tests.title: Crosswalk geometry and waiting points
tests.procedure: Create crossings with symmetric and unequal sidewalk/border widths; choose the declared depth basis; edit waiting point 2 of 3.
tests.expected: Full carriageway span and explicit depth resolve correctly; no ambiguous width policy; only selected waiting handle changes.

tests.title: Signal definitions and conflicts
tests.procedure: Create incompatible greens, missing controller, clearance violations and an allowed phase.
tests.expected: Invalid definitions block with exact movement/control IDs; valid phase definitions serialize without mutable live state.

tests.title: Full 3D local placement
tests.procedure: Move/rotate/bank the selected approach frame with nonzero XYZ/pitch/roll/yaw place offsets.
tests.expected: All services follow the full frame without drift; offsets remain local authored values.

tests.title: Reparent and independent handles
tests.procedure: Edit at least three bus waiting/seat handles; preserve-world then preserve-local reparent; cancel/undo/redo.
tests.expected: Siblings remain unchanged; both modes match documented math; transaction restores IDs, links and transforms.

tests.title: Complete bus-stop round-trip
tests.procedure: Save/reload and emit the complete entry/stop/exit, boarding/alighting, queue, seat and mesh-slot fixture.
tests.expected: Every field and typed vehicle/pedestrian connection survives; one default stop pose is not treated as complete coverage.

tests.title: Physical versus logical seats
tests.procedure: Create two benches with three logical seats each; move independent sitting poses and round-trip.
tests.expected: Two physical mesh instances and six logical seats retain distinct IDs, capacity and pose links.

tests.title: Parking authoring and bay access
tests.procedure: Create a 2×6 grid with nonzero gaps, angled/accessible bays and varied class rules.
tests.expected: Twelve stable bay poses and explicit entry/exit/walk links serialize; dynamic occupancy is not authored state.

tests.title: Hospital and city park
tests.procedure: Set an ambulance-only entrance, ordinary access and independent park walking entrances.
tests.expected: Vehicle and pedestrian targets reference legal entrances, not building/park centers; restrictions persist.

tests.title: Petrol pump and queues
tests.procedure: Create entry/exit driveway circulation, fuel-bay poses, waiting points and fuel/vehicle compatibility.
tests.expected: Approach and exit corridors, queues and restrictions survive save/reopen with no placeholder unvalidated access IDs.

tests.title: Independent payload and extension validation
tests.procedure: Round-trip each feature/place family separately; add a registered example type and an unknown compiler type.
tests.expected: Known schemas preserve every required field; unknown data is retained but publication is blocked until handled.

tests.title: Connectivity serialization
tests.procedure: Round-trip highway/lane graphs including shared junctions, loops and dead ends.
tests.expected: Stable IDs, ConnectedHighwayIds and legal directed edges survive; no actor pointer is runtime identity.

tests.title: Lane-change permission
tests.procedure: Query dashed/solid boundaries, opposing lanes, bus restrictions and prohibited junction intervals.
tests.expected: Adjacent but prohibited lanes are not returned as legal changes; interval and participant data are explicit.

tests.title: Directional adapter routes
tests.procedure: Find routes through 6→4→2 and reverse; remove a merge link and restrict one participant class.
tests.expected: All allowed routes use explicit mapping; invalid route returns NO_PATH with diagnostic context.

tests.title: Junction query rules
tests.procedure: Query each approach lane at mixed-profile T/cross/skewed junctions.
tests.expected: Only legal turns are returned; turn bans, class rules and U-turn policy are honored.

tests.title: Unique roundabout counts
tests.procedure: Query world/city scopes with four references to one roundabout and an intersection shared across cities.
tests.expected: One canonical ID appears once within each selected scope; boundary-membership policy is documented.

tests.title: Entry-relative roundabout exits
tests.procedure: Query single/multi-lane ring routes using both circulation directions, restricted exits and U-turn modes.
tests.expected: Physical port count is separate from legal onward exits; entry-relative ordering and reachability are correct.

tests.title: Service and walk reachability
tests.procedure: Query each parking bay, bus stop, hospital, park and fuel entrance for cars/buses/pedestrians.
tests.expected: Routes terminate at permitted access/interaction records; inaccessible destinations return typed failure.

tests.title: Projection and grade separation
tests.procedure: Project near parallel/stacked roads and far from the network using heading/elevation constraints.
tests.expected: No nearest-road jump across elevation/direction; out-of-bounds queries are explicit failures.

tests.title: Failure-state contract
tests.procedure: Request missing IDs, closed exit, unloaded graph chunk and stale snapshot revision.
tests.expected: Returns distinguish invalid, NO_PATH, CLOSED, DATA_UNAVAILABLE and STALE; no successful fake route.

tests.title: Gizmo and batch atomicity
tests.procedure: Move/rotate/allowed-scale multiple objects, include a read-only point, then cancel/undo/redo.
tests.expected: Correct include/skip preview; one accepted transaction; source geometry and sibling handles remain unchanged.

tests.title: Tool lifecycle
tests.procedure: Change mode, map, tab and selection during drag; invoke camera and native spline tools.
tests.expected: No stuck capture, transform fighting, stale callbacks or lost/incorrect selection.

tests.title: Debug budgets and always-draw
tests.procedure: Run declared large fixtures across near/far thresholds with modes/tabs changed.
tests.expected: Caps/LOD/culling work; selected diagnostics remain useful; cost is measured on declared hardware.

tests.title: Actionable validation
tests.procedure: Inject orphan link, bad mesh port, unresolved successor and conflicting signal; invoke Select and allowed Fix.
tests.expected: Exact offending entities are selected; accepted fixes are transactional; blockers remain until genuinely resolved.

tests.title: Registered extension and deterministic placement
tests.procedure: Register an advertisement/TV or approved new type; place by fixed seed; repeat build; try unknown type.
tests.expected: Known type uses all adapters and stable placement; unknown export blocks without deleting authored data.

tests.title: Expert and Basic usability
tests.procedure: Complete common tasks without Advanced; use keyboard-only expert tools at 1080p and scaled DPI in both themes.
tests.expected: Primary controls stay reachable and labeled; advanced capability does not become mandatory for routine authoring.

tests.title: Deterministic compile
tests.procedure: Compile identical canonical inputs twice, changing traversal order but not logical inputs.
tests.expected: Normalized payload hashes, IDs, lane mapping and manifests are equivalent; volatile metadata is excluded from content hashes.

tests.title: Atomic publish and stale inputs
tests.procedure: Change source/catalog mid-build; inject errors/cancel before publication and simulate failure at switch-over.
tests.expected: No partial or mixed-revision output is active; last valid package remains; stale build is rejected.

tests.title: Runtime completeness and schema
tests.procedure: Load/round-trip every specialized payload and graph in runtime-only context; test supported/unknown schema versions.
tests.expected: All required IDs/fields survive; editor modules are absent; incompatible schema is rejected without corrupting prior data.

tests.title: Lane following and containment
tests.procedure: Drive configured car/bus envelopes over straight/curved/banked roads, 6→4→2 and reverse adapters.
tests.expected: No wrong-way/unauthorized corridor exit in the approved scenarios; record trajectory, sweep method, tolerances and failures.

tests.title: Lane-change/merge safety
tests.procedure: Run valid lane-change intervals with safe and unsafe gaps, simultaneous merges and braking constraints.
tests.expected: Permission alone does not trigger motion; unsafe maneuvers wait/replan and approved priority is respected.

tests.title: Junction and roundabout travel
tests.procedure: Traverse T/cross/mixed-profile junctions and single/multi-lane roundabouts with missed/blocked exits.
tests.expected: Vehicles obey lane turns, yields and signals; legal recovery is used rather than cutting across the ring or teleporting.

tests.title: Crossings and signals at runtime
tests.procedure: Execute pedestrian phases, missing/stale controller states and competing vehicle/pedestrian movements.
tests.expected: Conflicting permission is not granted; invalid control data invokes the documented safe policy; waiting and clearance are observed.

tests.title: Runtime failure and projection
tests.procedure: Remove an edge, close access, unload the next graph chunk and place an agent near an overpass.
tests.expected: Explicit stop/wait/replan behavior; no straight-line off-road fallback, uncontrolled nearest-lane jump or hidden clamping.

tests.title: Bus and seat consumers
tests.procedure: Route bus entry/stop/exit and pedestrian queue/board/alight; contend for logical seats sharing benches.
tests.expected: Correct access/interaction poses and capacity; no double assignment; physical mesh count does not replace logical capacity.

tests.title: Parking and fuel service state
tests.procedure: Compete for one bay, expire a lease, occupy/release it, and unload/reload its visual proxy.
tests.expected: Reservation is owner-specific and exclusive; expiry cannot clear actual occupancy; GUID-keyed state survives proxy changes.

tests.title: Hospital/park/fuel route integration
tests.procedure: Drive/walk different participant classes to required service entrances and blocked/closed alternatives.
tests.expected: Permitted access only, including ambulance restrictions; never uses a mesh-center or placeholder route.

tests.title: Large-world graph and pooling
tests.procedure: Cross chunk boundaries and rebase origin under load while decorative actors deactivate/reactivate.
tests.expected: Graph availability is explicit and independent of visual actors; stable IDs/state persist; hysteresis and caps hold.

tests.title: Measured performance
tests.procedure: Execute the approved world-size and active-agent fixtures with specified hardware/build settings.
tests.expected: Publish actual median/tail timings, memory and actor counts against agreed budgets; unresolved budget failures block scale claims.

tests.title: Full regression and data safety
tests.procedure: Rerun all earlier phase suites; include save/reopen, crash recovery, undo/redo and generator ownership checks.
tests.expected: No accepted scenario regresses or authored data disappears; exact failures and deviations are documented.

tests.title: Clean delivery and end-to-end acceptance
tests.procedure: Extract on the recorded clean environment; build, launch, author, undo/redo, save, compile, run and export.
tests.expected: Documented commands succeed with real evidence; all phase decisions and final user release approval are recorded.
